title: NoApi route manifest
description: The routes NoApi responds to, and the responses. The first matching route is used.

source.description: Where the manifest was generated from (an OpenAPI document). For information only.

routes.description: The list of routes, in order of precedence.

items.description: A single route, defining the required request properties and the resulting response.

name.description: The name of the route (for logging and debugging).

method.description: The required http method(s), comma separated (e.g. "GET, POST"). Defaults to ANY.

path.description: A regex pattern to test the (url encoded) request path against. Use ^ and $ to match the whole path. Defaults to any path.

parameters.description: Requirements for query parameters or form fields. All must be met.

items.description: A query parameter or form field which must be present, with a value matching the pattern.

value.description: A regex pattern to test the value against. Defaults to any value.

response.description: The resulting response for this route.

path.description: The path to the content file, relative to the manifest. The file is read on each request. Without a path or a body, the body is empty.

body.description: The content, as an alternative to a file. A string is written as it is, any other value as json.

contentType.description: The content-type header of the response. Defaults to application/json.

statusCode.description: The status code of the response. Defaults to 200.
